tunnel_name.description: Name of the tunnel interface. Default is 'is0'.

interface.description: Tunnel link device. If specified, tunnel will be restricted to that device. 'auto' guesses the outgoing IPv4 address.

mtu.description: Sets the MTU for the tunnel device, minimum is 1280. 0 or 'auto' lets the kernel choose (usually 1480).

ttl.description: Set the tunnel hoplimit. Default is 64. 'auto' or 'inherit' makes the tunnel inherit the TTL from the linked device.

disable_pmtudisc.description: Disable (IPv4) Path MTU Discovery on this tunnel. Requires --ttl to be set to inherit for full effect.

routers.description: Set a potential router. Up to 10 potential routers can be specified. Default is the unqualified domainname 'isatap'. isatapd will resolve the hostname and add the IPv4 address to the PRL.

interval.description: Default interval to send router solicitations. If 0 or 'auto', the interval will be 80% of the router's lifetime. Can be used to force solicitations at a shorter interval.

dns_check_interval.description: Interval to perform DNS resolution of configured routers and to recreate the PRL, if necessary. Set to 0 to disable.

log_level.description: Verbosity of logging (controlled by -v/-q). isatapd logs to stderr when run in foreground and to syslog(3) using facility LOG_DAEMON.

log_file.description: Log file path. Use '-' to log to stdout/stderr.
